articles.summary: When a developer runs npx skills add, the installer copies the entire skill directory into the repo. If a malicious skill includes a *.test.ts file, it runs during npm test and silently give an attacker full access to the developer's machine.
articles.title: RCE in Your Test Suite: AI Agent Skills and the Attack Vector Skill Scanners Miss

articles.summary: Broken access control has been the #1 vulnerability class since 2021. This post explores why it's unsolved, why it will get worse, and how LLMs can bridge the gap.
articles.title: Business Logic Is AppSec's Unsolved Problem
